visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a red basketball jersey (number 23) sits outdoors at night. He has short black hair and small hoop earrings. He speaks and gestures with his hands. The background is a dimly lit urban street with warm streetlights. (2) An older man in a blue shirt and a dark baseball cap is outdoors during the day, working on a wooden structure. He gestures while speaking. (3) A young person with long dark hair tied back sits indoors, wearing a white t-shirt with a yellow sun graphic. They speak expressively and eventually laugh, covering their mouth. (4) An animated sequence shows a map of Southeast Asia and the Pacific. Text overlays and colored lines indicate geographic and linguistic connections. (5) A middle-aged man with bleached blonde hair sits outside during the day, looking serious. Behind him is a cluttered residential area. (6) An elderly man with grey hair and sunglasses on his forehead sits outdoors. The background is a scenic coastline with a prominent rock formation in the sea. He holds a small yellow sign. (7) A close-up of the older man in the blue shirt again, speaking with hand gestures. (8) A different elderly man in a blue polo shirt is interviewed outdoors. (10) Another young man in a blue t-shirt and necklace is interviewed outdoors, speaking to the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 因為蘭嶼跟台灣的原住民會比較不一樣的是. [Logo]: 哈哈台. (2) [Subtitle]: 我們蘭嶼比較會偏東南亞. [Variety]: 哇噻. (3) [Subtitle]: 因為蘭嶼的話比較不算高山族. 我們算海洋民族. (4) [Subtitle]: 我們算是菲律賓. [Variety]: 菲律賓人?. (5) [Subtitle]: 可是我們離菲律賓有點距離. 離台灣比較近. (6) [Subtitle]: 因為我們跟巴丹島那邊有70%的語言是相同的. [Variety]: 70%的語言是相同的. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以其實你們比較像菲律賓人. 然後被中華民國分掉. (8) [Variety]: 鵝~開玩笑 ^_^. (9) [Subtitle]: 雅美族語屬於南島語系中的巴丹語群. (10) [Subtitle]: 也是台灣唯一屬於馬來-波里尼西亞語族的原住民. (11) [Subtitle]: 被聯合國教科文組織認定為瀕危語言. (12) [Subtitle]: 而實際走訪蘭嶼後, 我們發現蘭嶼大哥們非常在乎一件事. (13) [Subtitle]: 蘭嶼就一個族而已啊, 雅美族啊. [Variety]: 雅美族. (14) [Subtitle]: 所以你們不會講是達悟族? 會, 可是比較... [Variety]: 不純正. (15) [Subtitle]: 我說實話啦. 你認同我們蘭嶼人是達悟族嗎?. (16) [Subtitle]: 認同啊. 你認同嗎? 認同啊. [Variety]: 我不認同. (17) [Subtitle]: 我們叫雅美族. 達悟(Tao)是人的名稱. (18) [Subtitle]: (雅美)這個名稱早就有勒. 在菲律賓, 他們只稱我們叫雅美(Yami). (19) [Subtitle]: 我不是達悟族, 是雅美族. (20) [Subtitle]: 那如果別人跟你說你是達悟族, 你會有一點不開心嗎? 不會啦, 就是比較... [Variety]: 話題比較很淺. (21) [Subtitle]: 因為雅美族的話是之前日治時代來, 鳥居龍藏, 有一個學家有來台灣. (22) [Subtitle]: 然後來蘭嶼之後, 可能要調查蘭嶼, 可能跟蘭嶼溝通, 但是他可能問你們是什麼. (23) [Subtitle]: 然後他說可能雅美, 然後他們聽成雅美, 後面就是打Yami, 後面就變雅美. (24) [Subtitle]: 騎車請記得戴安全帽. (25) [Subtitle]: 你們好像比較習慣用達悟, 我發現年輕一輩的話... 對, 我們比較喜歡自己叫是達悟族.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video investigates the cultural and linguistic identity of the indigenous people on Lanyu (Orchid Island), exploring the historical origins of the names 'Yami' and 'Tao' through interviews with various generations of residents and informative animations.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video blends street interviews with educational graphics to explain complex indigenous identity issues in an accessible way.
